kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Augmented (إِلْحَاق (ʔilḥāq)) from حَبْل (ḥabl, “rope”), two times to fuse a quinqueliteral from a triliteral, in reference to the astringent application of the plant. We see crosslinguistically that the habit of a composite stimulates speakers to multiply, and mnemotechny, relevant for the lexemic image of a plant, advises dichotomies and trichotomies: see Proto-Slavic *devęsilъ.
